The '''Zekulae system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Zeemacht Cluster/Legends|Zeemacht Cluster]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zekulae]].
